summary: Master Metadata Standards for Digital Records. Learn Dublin Core and ISO 23081 to enhance discoverability and compliance. Register for expert-led training.
lede: Metadata Standards for Digital Records training shows you how to structure descriptions for digital objects so information is easier to find, exchange, trust, and manage throughout its lifecycle. You will work with the Dublin Core Metadata Element Set, the ISO 23081 suite, and ISO 15489 as a foundation for building consistent records management practices. The course covers schema design, crosswalks between different data sets, data dictionaries, AI-supported metadata extraction, and metadata quality auditing for preservation. It also introduces advanced RDF modeling and linked data architectures, helping you distinguish practical implementation work from overview-level concepts while supporting migrations, retrieval, and audit readiness.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals responsible for the integrity, findability, and long-term preservation of organizational information assets.
modules: Foundations of Metadata for Digital Records
Designing Metadata Schemas and Data Dictionaries
Metadata Implementation in EDRMS and Cloud
Governance, Quality Control, and Metadata Auditing
Strategic Metadata Management and Stakeholder Reporting
prerequisites: Participants should have an intermediate understanding of records management principles or information technology systems. Familiarity with ISO 15489 or basic XML/HTML structures is recommended but not mandatory. This course is ideal for those currently managing digital repositories, archives, or corporate document management systems.
